name: extract_contact_details
description: Capture the verified contact details: `{{first_name}}`, `{{last_name}}`, `{{company_name}}`, `{{prospect_timezone}}` (IANA), `{{is_calling_best_number}}`, `{{callback_number}}`. Call it once multiple details are provided, and again before you're done. `{{callback_number}}` may already be seeded from the inbound call — update it only when the prospect gives a different number.

variables.name: first_name
variables.description: Prospect's first name (may already exist from an earlier capture)

variables.name: company_name
variables.description: Company / business name (may already exist from an earlier capture)

variables.name: prospect_timezone
variables.description: Prospect's timezone in IANA format for scheduling. Speak the friendly name (Eastern/Central/Pacific/Mountain) aloud but store IANA.

variables.name: is_calling_best_number
variables.description: True if the user confirmed the number they're calling from is the best contact number. False if they provided an alternate number instead.

variables.name: callback_number
variables.description: The prospect's contact number, seeded from the inbound call webhook. Update to the alternate number only when is_calling_best_number = false.

name: contact_details_completed
description: Set contact_details_completed to true ONLY after: When first name, last name, company, timezone and best number are all collected and verified. Do not set it early.

variables.name: contact_details_completed
variables.description: true ONLY after: When first name, last name, company, timezone and best number are all collected and verified.
